## ProviderResults type

Per requested provider, by its id, its result. A provider asked as itself has its own key and typed rows: a key that is always there when the providers are a list written out (a tuple) and that element is one provider, and a key that may be missing when the element may be one of several (`cond ? lines : names`<!-- -->) or the list is an array. A provider asked by id is read by any string, as a field picker reads it, and may be missing.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type ProviderResults<Ps extends readonly ProviderRef[] = readonly string[]> = {
    readonly [Q in Asked<Ps> | Extract<Ps[number], string> as Q extends ProviderBase ? Q["id"] : string]: ProviderResult<FieldsOf<Q>>;
} & {
    readonly [Q in Exclude<Extract<Ps[number], ProviderBase>, Asked<Ps>> as Q["id"]]?: ProviderResult<FieldsOf<Q>>;
};
```
